notes.title: A bit of QoL
notes.content:
Small patch:
[list]
[*] Grace period increased when attempting to jump right when hitting the ground
[*] Mouse cursor now insisting on hiding itself while a level is running
[*] Added options to disable Bipt's trail, and to show all collectibles on the HUD
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*] There is a game breaking bug, causing the game to render a grey screen. This has been reproduced in house exactly twice. When I sat down to fix it, I spent an hour and a half trying to get it to happen again to no avail. I am going to fix this as soon as I can manage. Apologies to those affected.
[*] The keyboard input experience is not great. The directional nature of the teleport works best with a controller stick, and the game congealed around controller input. I'd like to add input remapping at some point to make the KBM experience nicer.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre configured color palettes added
notes.content:
I have added a few color palettes to a dropdown, in addition to being able to configure your own colors. Enjoy a few more options than the original colors!

- Kitchin
